title: cli: `fiber sessions | head` prints a broken pipe error
note: Closed-stdout pipe case was never exercised; unit tests used in-memory writers that fail with Other, not BrokenPipe; fix added binary tests with a real closed pipe.

title: tui: at 120 columns, session titles run into ids and rail labels cut mid-word
note: Layout found in a tmux smoke test at 120 columns; screen tests cover other widths (80 columns ticket #4280) and docs set no cut rule; still open.

title: config: with the workspace at $HOME, Fiber home's config.json is also read as the repository layer
note: Workspace equal to $HOME makes .fiber the same directory as Fiber home; docs and tests never covered the overlap; fix added config unit tests.

title: doctor: prints one model_unconfigured line per model for providers never set up
note: Earlier #3582 grouping fixed terminal and fiber models but doctor, a second consumer of the same notices, was not wired to it or tested.

title: tui: exits by itself with code 1 and nothing on stderr, at startup or resume under tmux
note: Silent exit 1 under tmux; fix removed a cursor-position query in repaint that raced the input reader, and added a pty binary test; fake backends never answered like real tmux.

title: reviewer: allows a passwordless sudo apt-get install at stage 1 when the person asked for a per-user pip install
note: The reviewer model judged a privileged system install wrongly; a reviewer eval set exists but lacked this case and live model behaviour is not gated; fix added eval fixtures.

title: Host calls refused for their origin answer not_available, not invalid_arguments
note: Owner ruled the error code wrong; existing tests pinned invalid_arguments for the origin refusals, and the fix flipped those tests.

title: Process extensions: host.tool from a command callback
note: Doc promises host.tool from commands for process extensions; command path never given an inner-call source, split from #4664; found by doc-versus-code audit.

title: Model picker footer clips with the longer Tab label at narrow widths
note: Found in PR review; the clipped footer snapshot was merged as accepted output because no doc says how the footer degrades; still open.

title: Release: the feedback report mislabels source builds, and the installer's PATH rule for other shells
note: Doc-versus-code audit; install_method keyed on a bracket in the version, so source builds read as install.sh; second half is doc wording fix.

title: Two project paths can share one project key
note: docs/state.md called a slug collision harmless, yet per-project rules and data live under the key; the doc itself was the wrong spec; still open.

title: Compaction: check the trigger before the first measured reply, and report a failed artifact write
note: Resumed session skips the automatic compaction trigger until a reply measures context, and an artifact write error is swallowed; neither case had a loop test.

title: Linux sandbox grants read on every device under /dev
note: The ancestor walk granted read on /dev contrary to the doc; the sandbox tests did not try reading another device such as /dev/zero.

title: Process extensions: host.exec resolves a relative program inside the package
note: Lua path called resolve_in_package but the process path passed program through unchanged; the Lua test existed, the process counterpart did not.

title: Settings: an unset value reads Default
note: shown_value handled only some control kinds; other unset controls showed Not Set or none, contrary to the doc line.

title: Swapped views: Space and a click do what Enter does
note: Doc says Space and click equal Enter in every swapped view, but only Enter was wired; the issue is still open after two fix attempts.

title: Shell output and prompt-history write failures are dropped unreported
note: Write failures were silently dropped, found by a debt ledger sweep; the fix test level was not checked.

title: Resumed session undercounts permission blocks a person answered or a cancel ended
note: The history fold on resume counts only reviewer denials, so the 20-block limit resets partly; known debt marker; fix test level was not checked.

title: Process extensions: host.tool, host.model and host.delegate always fail because the session never wires their services
note: Process host services were never installed in a live session; tests used stub NativeHostServices, so the missing production wiring was invisible; found by overbuild audit.

title: model_omitted is not emitted on warm-cache startups that skip add_lua
note: Notice was emitted only when add_lua ran; warm-cache startup and disabled-process paths skipped it; found in a lane review of #4609 and fixed with a Databricks binary test.

title: An advisory applies to main
note: New RUSTSEC advisory for rustix appeared after merge; fixed by dependency bump; not a defect in Fiber code.

title: docs/tools.md deferral rule needs the Databricks claude-sonnet-4-5 gateway exception
note: A docs sentence needed updating after #4617 dropped Sonnet 4.5 deferral rows for Databricks; doc wording only.

title: keeper dead at refuse-only socket wait expiry (#4351 follow-up)
note: Intermittent keeper test expiry under stress with an unobservable keeper bind; fix named the dead keeper in the test failure; whether a product defect remains is unknown.
